hero.heading: Making life | a little
hero.tagline: Hi, I’m Jerin. | I write software for a living.

about.markdown:
I'm a backend engineer who likes building the parts of software you never see but always rely on: the services, data and systems that keep things working quietly in the background.

These days my interest is in distributed systems: how many machines work together as one, and how a system keeps going when some of them fail. Right now I'm building a distributed key-value store from scratch to learn exactly that, one piece at a time.

I also love building complete software, from the first idea to something people can use, whenever the project lines up with what I care about.
